title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning with TD3+BC: five seeds per arm beside their clones, on held-out links, sharing and alone
description: The held-out report of the TD3+BC arms chosen by exp-lcf-cost-td3-search-327: paper (neto1 v1's seven values; alpha 2.5, 60,000 updates) and free (seven free latents from an encoder of neto1 v1's architecture trained by the critic's loss; alpha 2.5, 150,000 updates), training seeds 0 and 1 from exp-lcf-cost-td3-326 and 2 to 4 from exp-lcf-cost-td3-seeds-328, beside the clones of BBRv3 that the earlier runs reported (lcft-paper-none and lcft-freefix-none, seeds 0 and 1 from exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317, 2 to 4 from exp-lcf-cost-teacher-seeds-321). Four campaigns repeat the conditions of the earlier reports exactly: 300 of net2's training links not used by either search (links 100 to 399, campaign seed 32, as exp-lcf-cost-report-322), 300 links no training data had (net2-train-xl links 0 to 299, seed 33, as exp-lcf-cost-unseen-323), and both again with the flow alone (seeds 34 and 35, as exp-lcf-cost-alone-325), 30 s, every policy and BBRv3 on every episode. summary.md gives each configuration minus another, each averaged over its five seeds and paired by link with a 95% bootstrap interval over links, then each policy's score minus BBRv3 per campaign.
prepare: P=(); for s in 0 1 2 3 4; do T="$IN/t"; F="$IN/p"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && { T="$IN/u"; F="$IN/s"; }; for c in lcft-paper-none lcft-freefix-none; do P+=(--policy "$c-s$s=$T/$c-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; for c in lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k; do P+=(--policy "$c-s$s=$F/$c-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 40 ]; for x in "${P[@]}"; do [ "$x" = --policy ] || [ -f "${x#*=}" ]; done; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train" --links 100:400 --seed 32 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen" --links 0:300 --seed 33 --set net2-train-xl --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train-alone" --links 100:400 --seed 34 --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen-alone" --links 0:300 --seed 35 --set net2-train-xl --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; for k in train unseen train-alone unseen-alone; do cmp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/spec-$k/aliases.json"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$k/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$k"; done; cp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --over-seeds; uv run python experiments/arm_versus.py "$OUT" lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k lcft-freefix-none:lcft-paper-none lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:lcft-freefix-none lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k:lcft-paper-none lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:bbr3 lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k:bbr3 lcft-freefix-none:bbr3 lcft-paper-none:bbr3; { cat "$OUT/versus.md"; echo; cat "$OUT/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.tmp"; mv "$OUT/summary.tmp" "$OUT/summary.md"; for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign summary "$c" > "$OUT/metrics-${c##*/c-}.json"; done
